expect_nodes.name: users
expect_nodes.note: INTENDED: `op.create_table("users", ...)` in an alembic revision declares the table. No migration routing exists today (matrix_vocab: 'no dedicated kind exists; review rank 15 proposes migration routing'), so this is EXPECTED to miss.

expect_edges.note: INTENDED: the revision module touches the table it creates. MEASURED: the only ACCESSES_DATA edge goes to the DATABASE node `data_source:sqlalchemy` — the driver, not the table.

forbid.name: sqlalchemy
forbid.note: precision: the ORM/driver name must never be minted as a table entity. It is currently emitted as kind DATABASE, which is correct; this pins that it does not drift into DATA_ENTITY and make the cell look covered.

note: ZERO-EVERYWHERE PROBE (A15.11). Measures, rather than asserts, that an alembic migration yields no table entity. Baseline 2026-09-16 on the installed 0.4.18 wheel: 4 nodes / 4 edges, DATA_ENTITY 0.
